caption: A sheet of paper pulled from both sides tears outward from a small notch and remains separated into two pieces.

clauses.text: The paper must have a small notch at its center before tearing begins.
The hands must grip the paper on opposite sides and pull it apart symmetrically.
The tear must originate from the notch and propagate outward along the paper's surface.
The paper must separate into two distinct pieces after the tear completes.
